summary: A novelty firmware that plays ten recorded CC0 fart samples across the keys, with reverb, delay and a one-bar loop recorder.
features: Ten one-shot samples repeated across all 27 keys
One-bar, 16-step loop with overdub, quantized to the step
Knobs set reverb, delay amount, delay time and feedback
Eight voices; MIDI channel 1 notes play and record
Own WAV files can replace the bank when rebuilding
Loop is lost at power-off; no MIDI clock sync or song mode
